Definition
[Bianchi map and algebraic curvature operators] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0108, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0109 \group Algebraic Curvature Operators For a covariant four-tensor $R$, set \[ b(R)(x,y,z,t)=\frac13\bigl(R(x,y,z,t)+R(y,z,x,t)+R(z,x,y,t)\bigr). \] An element of $S^2(\Lambda ^2E)$ is an algebraic curvature operator when it lies in $\ker b$; their space is denoted $\mathcal A_n$.
